From Anhes:

Finally, for those who wanted to know about the points, I can give a brief explanation.

For example, Nobu would have received his mark for having a tendency to be overweight. Matt would be a mixed-race person. Regarding Lug, he naturally did something to Clarisse; however, Lug was initially given two marks, since, coming from a distant place, he didn't belong to any pre-existing bloodline.

Regarding the Popess, throughout the chapter there will be clues that will make her nature quite evident.
